news.headline: USC's Eric Gentry to redshirt after 'series of concussions'
news.description: USC linebacker Eric Gentry, who was leading the team in tackles and sacks through the first four games, will redshirt the rest of the 2024 season after suffering "a series of concussions in a short period of time."

news.headline: USC defensive end Anthony Lucas out for season
news.description: USC defensive end Anthony Lucas will miss the rest of the season due to a "lower extremity" injury, head coach Lincoln Riley announced Tuesday.

news.headline: Jayden Daniels again delivers in 'high-pressure' situation for Commanders
news.description: After failing multiple times in late-game situations earlier this season, Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels put together a second consecutive winning drive Monday night as Washington kicked a last-second field goal to beat Cincinnati 22-20.

news.headline: Commanders' Jayden Daniels-themed post aimed at Bengals tops NFL Week 11 trolls
news.description: NFL teams remained petty in Week 11, led by a post from the Washington Commanders.

news.headline: Commanders building momentum, halt Bengals' 5-game win streak
news.description: The Commanders' defense held the potent Bengals in check and Washington has won three of four.

news.headline: Seahawks to monitor Sam Darnold status this week before final call vs. 49ers
news.description: The Seahawks still plan to start Sam Darnold against the 49ers but will wait to see how the QB looks in practice Wednesday before making a final call.

news.headline: NFL Week 11 arrivals: Tee Higgins pays homage to Fiona the Hippo ahead of 'MNF'
news.description: NFL stars continue to turn game-day arrivals into their own weekly fashion showcase.

news.headline: Struggling Ravens noncommittal on whether Humphrey will play Sunday vs. Texans
news.description: A day after he was a healthy scratch in a 35-33 loss at the Panthers following a derogatory comment he made about the city of Baltimore, the Ravens were noncommittal on whether cornerback Marlon Humphrey would play Sunday against the Texans.

news.headline: Sources: Packers' Micah Parsons cleared to make season debut Wednesday vs. Rams
news.description: Packers star Micah Parsons has been cleared and is set for his season debut against the Rams on Wednesday night, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

Anthony Lucas may refer to:

Anthony Francis Lucas (1855–1921), Croatian-born American oil explorer
Anthony T. Lucas (1911–1986), Irish archaeologist, historian and museologist
Anthony Lucas (wide receiver) (born 1976), American football wide receiver
Anthony Lucas (defensive end) (born 2004), American football defensive end

transactions.text: Placed LB Jack Campbell on injured reserve. Signed DB Nick Whiteside to the active roster. Elevated DE Anthony Lucas and RB Jabari Small from the practice squad.

Signed T Blake Miller, DE Derrick Moore, LB Jimmy Rolder, DB Keith Abney II, WR Kendrick Law and DTs Skyler Gill-Howard and Tyre West to rookie contracts. Signed QB Luke Altmyer, T Melvin Priestly, TE Miles Kitselman, DT Aidan Keanaaina, DEsAnthony Lucas and Eric O'Neil, DE Erick Hunter and DBs Aamaris Brown and De'Shawn Rucker to UDFA contracts.

insights: Entered the league in 2026 as an undrafted free agent.
